inputs.zero_expectation_proof: For fixed b,u,p, transform phi to pi-phi modulo2pi and z to -z. Radius and phase sine are unchanged while cosine changes sign. Symmetric Gauss-Legendre nodes preserve this oddness exactly apart from floating-point error. Both central phase interval around pi/2 and its wrapped complement are invariant under the phase involution, so each stratum control expectation is exactly zero. The phase-independent gap mask preserves zero expectation.

interpretation: The stratified estimator preserves the full specified bounded incoming measure and the original reflected and transmitted weights.
The first-Born control has exactly zero phase expectation by the phi-to-pi-minus-phi and z-to-minus-z symmetry; the numerical control is a finite symmetric quadrature function.

The controlled calculation reanalyses the same fresh trajectories. Its historical-only coefficient and mask were fixed before control evaluation; it is not a second independent physical campaign or a formal preregistered statistical test.

The physical phase-paired extension splits every old incoming weight equally between its original state and its actual nonlinear phase partner. The measure-preserving involution cancels the leading odd first-Born term, without implying cancellation of the nonlinear response or a variance-reduction guarantee.
Partners are correlated; the four independent randomized low-discrepancy samples retain their original independent randomizations. The alternate-partition sample is separate.
The fixed-pair movie shows two zero-center-of-mass physical experiments, not a thermal center-of-mass average. Its nonuniform playback clock and original saved sample times are recorded.
Sample, scramble, alternate-partition and control-order differences are empirical convergence comparisons, not confidence intervals or rigorous error bounds.

The four comparison denominators are [I2/mu_ref,I2,I2,IR] from the designated fine/reference case. Passing a 5 percent signed-mean or cross gate does not establish 5 percent relative accuracy in that small signed integral.
Negative signed drift in the cropped incoming band does not imply net cooling of a complete equilibrium plasma.
Outgoing inverse-cutoff violations are kinematic finite-plane diagnostics, not a validation of detailed balance.
The normalized magnetic-moment to guiding-center squared-kick ratio is density independent within this bounded model; it is not a measured kinetic mixing-time ratio.
